svg.title: The coefficient approximations used for both inclusion and (QD1) have subexponential top- coordinate cost: for every ε > 0, their pullback to the terminal frame is eventually bounded by exp(εsN), where sN is the calendar scale. For bounded reference coefficients this follows by multiplying the backward column bounds: their logarithm is P i<N log Ci. The calendar gives log Ci ≤ε log Li/2 after a fixed level, so the tail is at most ε(sN −sk)/2; the finite head is absorbed
